title: Huang calls Astra AGI; ARC dual-harness undercuts 99.9%
summary: Huang calls Astra AGI; ARC’s dual-harness scores undercut the 99.9% claim.

sections.heading: What cleared the bar
bullets: Nvidia CEO Jensen Huang says GPT-6 Astra is AGI (“AGI has arrived”); Brockman says we’re moving into the AGI era.
TNW: ARC Prize standard harness scores Astra 62.7% vs OpenAI Provider Adapter 99.9%; ARC declines AGI claim; post-launch metric edits documented.
Pachocki’s “An Alien Mind” asks labs for shared slowdown bars as OpenAI hits automated research-intern goal.
Inside Anthropic Labs (~20 people, Ben Mann): Claude Code / MCP / Claude Design incubator as IPO nears.
NYT: Blacklisted Inspur’s Aivres arm routed $5.6B+ advanced tech incl. $3B+ Nvidia Blackwell servers via SE Asia.

bottomLine: AGI rhetoric from Nvidia collided with ARC’s much lower standard-harness score, while safety and chip-export stories kept stacking.
